description: 18 questions over 5 HR documents. Ground truth = the document that actually answers the question. Several questions are deliberately hard for pure semantic search (semantic overlap between docs, or answers only findable by exact numbers/terms).

questions.question: Can I expense the alcohol I bought at a client dinner?
questions.why_hard: Trap: the Code of Conduct has a whole section on 'entertainment' (food/drink from suppliers), so semantic search may pull the wrong document.

questions.question: My hotel in London is expensive - what is the maximum the company pays per night?
questions.why_hard: The exact number $325 is what answers it; embeddings often miss precise numbers.

questions.question: Do I need to keep a receipt to get reimbursed?
questions.why_hard: Answer depends on a threshold ($25) that appears many times in the doc.

questions.question: I drive my own car for work trips. What do I get paid back?
questions.why_hard: Answer is a proper noun (IRS) + specific rate.

questions.question: My expenses this month total $1,200. Who has to approve them?
questions.why_hard: The $1,000 threshold must be matched, not just the word 'approve'.

questions.question: Can I work from home to look after my kids instead of using daycare?
questions.why_hard: The policy explicitly says remote work is NOT for childcare - a semantic search may return a superficially related chunk.

questions.question: The town wants to end my remote work arrangement. How much notice do they have to give?
questions.why_hard: Answer is a number (10 days) buried in a long legal sentence.

questions.question: Am I covered by workers' compensation if I get injured working from home?
questions.why_hard: 'Injury at home' could pull the home-office safety section instead.

questions.question: How often is my routine remote work agreement reviewed?
questions.why_hard: Answer is a specific date (annually by June 30).

questions.question: How do I officially ask to work from home?
questions.why_hard: Proper noun form name ('Remote Work Application').

questions.question: Do I get my job back after maternity leave?
questions.why_hard: Maternity leave is one of many leave types in the same document.

questions.question: I've been sick for a while. When do I need to provide a doctor's note?
questions.expected_phrase: medical certificate is required for sick leave
questions.why_hard: Several docs mention sick leave/illness; only this one has the certificate rule.

questions.question: Can I carry over my unused vacation days to next year?
questions.why_hard: 'Vacation' also appears in the Remote Work policy's leave section.

questions.question: Can I take a second part-time job while working here?
questions.why_hard: Trap: 'part-time' also appears in the Expense and Leave policy scopes.

questions.question: A vendor offered me a gift. Can I keep it?
questions.why_hard: Gift rules live only in the Code of Conduct.

questions.question: I'm choosing suppliers and my cousin owns one of the bidding companies. What do I do?
questions.why_hard: A scenario question - the answer requires matching to the conflict-of-interest rule.

questions.question: What happens if I refuse to learn AI tools at work?
questions.why_hard: Consequences section; no other doc covers AI.

questions.question: Where do we document which AI tools our team uses?
questions.why_hard: Answer is an exact filename: skill.md.
